Landmine amputation as an exogenous shock to poverty in Cambodia. Identified, but neither axis is this chapter's.

Health perceptions of Turkish over-65s living at home.

Method for reconstructing birth histories from US census children-ever-born data.

Ethnography of parenting in THREE-GENERATION Taipei families, on collaboration and conflict by social class. The extended configuration described from the inside; the outcome is child-rearing practice.
Support from children and depressive symptoms among rural Chinese elders.
No abstract; validation of a maternal burnout scale.
What criteria Hungarians consider necessary for adulthood, with INDEPENDENCE and family transitions among them, ESS. The subjective adult-status mechanism §1 names, measured as an attitude.
No abstract; predictors of food insecurity.
Child maltreatment in Bangladesh.
Modernisation and elder care in Taiwan.
Parental intimate partner violence and PRECOCIOUS transitions to adulthood. Early home-leaving as an outcome of violence.
Sex-biased parental care in Tanzania.
Childlessness and UNION histories in Finnish register data. A.7's union variable; register quality is notable.
Income and life satisfaction among the elderly.
Swedish essays on partnering, fertility, divorce and HOUSEHOLD FORMATION and dissolution at the individual longitudinal level. Register-grade data covering both links; trace the chapters.

HOUSEHOLD PRECARIOUSNESS and youth LIVING ARRANGEMENTS in SPAIN across a complete business cycle, with the stated consequence that economic difficulty delays EMANCIPATION AND CHILDBEARING. The registered setting, both links, and a full cycle rather than a single recession -- which is closer to a repeated natural experiment than most of the arm.

Nationalist legal reform of TONGYANG, the adoptive daughter-in-law reared in her husband's household from childhood. A marriage form DEFINED by co-residence, and a legal reform abolishing it -- a design-6 candidate in a historical Chinese setting.

'Curse of the Mummy-ji': how MOTHERS-IN-LAW constrain young married women's social networks, mobility and REPRODUCTIVE HEALTH in patrilocal rural India, framed explicitly as intergenerational power dynamics WITHIN THE HOUSEHOLD. The extended arm's mechanism at its most direct, with network data.

RESIDENTIAL INDEPENDENCE and labour attachment of Spanish youth analysed BY AUTONOMOUS COMMUNITY. Within-country regional variation in the registered setting -- exactly what Wall 3 asks for and what the cross-national backbone records cannot supply.
Hyperactivity in primary schooling.

Companion to the preceding record and the stronger of the pair: RESIDENTIAL INDEPENDENCE, labour attachment AND FERTILITY of Spanish youth by autonomous community. Leaving the parental home and having children in one regional analysis, in the setting the registered claim is about. Priority read; likely duplicate pair with W3011464401 -- resolve at assembly.
No abstract; postpartum contraception guidance.
Demographic and family structure change and income distribution in Hungary and the OECD.
No abstract; birth spacing and female labour market participation in urban China.
Single parents' support of students in Ghana.
Late-life living arrangements of older Mexican-origin Americans.
No abstract; fertility cost, INTERGENERATIONAL LABOUR DIVISION and female employment. C.2.a's exposure with a labour outcome -- both route-outs.
'POSTPONED ADULTHOOD, the Inequality Surge, and the Millennial Burden'. Essayistic, but it names the pre-launch delay as a distributional phenomenon rather than a demographic one.
Burnout among male carers of people with dementia at home.

Family impact on individual careers in industrialising Catalonia, explicitly in a society where STEM OR JOINT FAMILIES were important. Tests modernisation's nuclearisation claim; historical, and the outcome is status attainment.
Shared time among same-sex and different-sex coresident couples.
Motherhood and careers in anaesthesiology.

Cross-lagged models of marital relationships and intergenerational conflict across the TRANSITION TO PARENTHOOD, with the effect of PATRILINEAL CORESIDENCE. Co-residence as a moderator of what happens after a birth rather than a cause of it -- but the cross-lagged design is the closest thing in the extended arm to modelling the two directions at once.
Parents' role when young people MOVE AWAY FROM HOME, noting that moves have grown more TEMPORARY AND REVERSIBLE. The reversibility point matters for §9: leaving home is not an absorbing state.
Rapid repeat pregnancy and child maltreatment risk in China.
Housing conditions and handwashing in Lima.
No abstract; children and retirement saving.

No abstract; 'MULTIGENERATIONAL HOUSEHOLDS: A Descriptive Approach to Distinctive Definitions'. A definitional paper on the exposure -- directly useful for §9's ARRANGEMENT_MEASURE and §6's configuration split. Trace.
Health and marital status of older Chinese couples and implications for intergenerational co-residence.
Editorial on motherhood and medical specialty choice.
Two Italian studies a decade apart on the transition to adulthood. Repeated cross-sections in the registered setting; the 2003/2013 gap spans the crisis.

Transition from LIVING APART TOGETHER to CO-RESIDING, and whether pre-partnership children affect it. The LAT configuration studied as a transition rather than a state -- the fullest treatment of it in the frame.
Empty-nest psychosocial stress under economic crisis. Parents'-side outcome.
